title: [nightly/feature] Notes on a round: write, edit and clear them on the round page
summary: Golfers can now keep a note on any round (the wind, a club that worked, a hole to play differently) from a Notes card on the round page, and clear it again; the API has stored notes all along but the app never showed or wrote them.

18 macOS screenshot baselines need regenerating (12 round-detail, 2 Input preview, 4 new note shots).
